text_block_list.text: One day, while walking through town, I ran into Fuji Kiseki giving directions in front of an outdoor stage.
choice_data_list: Could it be, you're putting on another play?
Could it be, you're putting on another play?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, <chrname>!
Yeah, we're doing a rerun of that play we put on with everyone from the Ritto Dormitory before.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: When I attended a "tea party" hosted by my fan club earlier, the regulars asked if we could do it again since they'd prepare a stage for us.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm right in the middle of getting everything ready as the director and stage manager.
Feel free to come watch if you'd like!
choice_data_list: I'd love to go, of course, but—

text_block_list.text: I heard the whole thing, Fuji-san!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Pokke, and... are those your old friends from your freestyle racing days behind you?
What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be blunt with ya.
Fuji-san, let us handle all the staff work!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Where you belong is up on that stage, right?! You gotta be in the play! I'll bust my tail working for it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I appreciate the thought, but it might be better if I handle stage management myself.
Since that's the chief supervisor position over the entire staff.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Chief supervisor? Bring it on!
Setting up any stage, safety checks included—I'll pull it off without a hitch!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's comin' here just to see you, Fuji-san.
So you gotta perform! Come on!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But...
choice_data_list: If you want to make your fans happy, you really should perform!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Right on! Please, Fuji-san!
I want everyone to see your acting!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
............ Yeah, you're right.
You used to lead your crew as their leader. You might actually be suited for stage management.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All right.
I'll trust Pokke and take the stage!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!!
All right, let's check the schedule and assign everyone's roles.
If any of you do a half-assed job, you'll answer to me!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then... the question is what role I should play.
To avoid making everyone re-memorize their lines, I'm thinking of adding a standalone scene for myself, but...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Since you're here, let me ask you.
What kind of role would you like to see me perform?
choice_data_list: A magician captivating the audience with flashy magic
A narrator guiding the story to hype up the play

text_block_list.text: The next day, upon arriving at the audience seats to watch the play—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, this stage was organized by Fuji-sama, wasn't it?
Why are there such rough-looking girls here?

text_block_list.name: Roughly-Dressed Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Huh? We got seats reserved for us as thanks for helping set up the stage.
Got a problem with that?!

An elegantly dressed adult and Jungle Pocket's horse girl friend glared at each other.
With no other empty seats around, I sat between them...

The opening announcement played, and the performance began.
Around the midpoint of the story, Fuji Kiseki appeared alongside memorable music.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, pony-chan.
Crushed by a sorrowful destiny, shedding bitter tears... Poor thing...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But fear not, for I am here now.
I shall cast a spell of courage upon you so you may carve open your destiny! Hah!

As Fuji Kiseki clapped her hands, confetti rained down from the stage, turning into lovely flowers amidst puffs of white smoke.
The audience seats transformed into a flower field, eliciting cheers from the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All right, now I'd like the pony-chans in the audience to assist in this miracle.
Come, pluck a flower and gently blow on the fluff!

Prompted, I picked a nearby flower and blew on the fluff.
As it drifted upward, it burst like soap bubbles, illuminating the sky with kaleidoscopic rainbow light.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, do you feel courage welling up within you now?
Our dreamlike time together draws to a close.
I wish you the best of luck, pony-chan!

text_block_list.name: Roughly-Dressed Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO~~~~!! What in the world was that?!!
So freakin' cooool~! I can't stop clappiiing!!
The next day, upon arriving at the audience seats to watch the play—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, this stage was organized by Fuji-sama, wasn't it?
Why are there such rough-looking girls here?

text_block_list.name: Roughly-Dressed Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Huh? We got seats reserved for us as thanks for helping set up the stage.
Got a problem with that?!

An elegantly dressed adult and Jungle Pocket's horse girl friend glared at each other.
With no other empty seats around, I sat between them...

The opening announcement played, and the performance began.
Around the midpoint of the story, Fuji Kiseki appeared alongside memorable music.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the young man gazes up at the sky, baring his innermost feelings.
Yet, there is none who can hear his plea.
A wind carrying the lingering humidity of midday blows past.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Will this story conclude in tragedy as is?!
No, none of us desire such a sorrowful ending!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Come now, everyone, observers of this tale!
Clap your hands and bestow your blessings upon them!
So that they may grasp a future filled with hope!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, more! Give me more!
Let us deliver light to them through your power!
Clap your hands!

Moved by Fuji Kiseki's passionate plea, everyone in the audience clapped fervently.
Then, with dramatic music, the light returned to the stage.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone!
Now, the story at last approaches its climax—
When the grand finale arrives, grant us your applause once more!

text_block_list.name: Roughly-Dressed Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO~~~~!! What in the world was that?!!
So freakin' cooool~! I can't stop clappiiing!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, how noisy... hehe.
Still, to witness such a wonderful performance, I am truly grateful to Fuji-sama!

text_block_list.name: Roughly-Dressed Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, lady, ya got time after this?
Let's talk about the show over some pudding!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member
text_block_list.text:
I am not an old lady! ...Though, I suppose this bond too was forged by Fuji-sama.
Very well, let's go!
After all the spectators had departed, Fuji Kiseki and Jungle Pocket were talking beneath the stage.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san, you're seriously incredible!!
To unite everyone's hearts with pure emotion like that!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
An actor could ask for nothing more.
Thank you, Pokke.
Managing the stage must have been tough, right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh,
that wasn't tough at all!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ that was awesome. I wanna see it again.
At this rate, why not make it a regular performance?
I'll be the stage manager again anytime!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That sounds fun too.
Just don't forget, Pokke—the ultimate stage for me will always be the turf.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I want to bring joy to long-time fans, first-time viewers, and the staff supporting the races alike... through my running!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
I'm one of those folks who was captivated by your running after all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, Fuji-san, you could captivate any person, any horse girl!
After all, everyone acknowledges you're a true entertainer!
